description: This file defines the DictionaryLocale class, which holds data about locales for use in a language selection spinner in the UI of the AnySoftKeyboard app.

classes.name: DictionaryLocale
classes.description: A class representing a locale with its code and display name, used for language selection in the UI.

methods.name: getLocale
methods.description: Returns the locale code associated with this DictionaryLocale instance.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation combining the locale name and code.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the locale code.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on the locale code.
